request_scope: One additional review/analysis/fix round; no commit or push.
change_scale: Targeted shared save, campaign VM/input, reinforcement and summon-rule changes; meaningful new reproductions plus risk-related existing regression.

fixed_findings.issue: Hub TAB/A shortcuts replaced pending dialogue or choices and stranded the source VM
fixed_findings.fix: Status/system menus open only during idle hub exploration without active VM or motion. Existing callback remains until completion.

fixed_findings.issue: Hub manual save claimed success after failed write
fixed_findings.fix: Display the actual production save_game result; failed write creates neither save nor temporary file.

fixed_findings.issue: v1 migration captured a one-member route party in the retry snapshot despite existing recruits
fixed_findings.fix: Synchronize the actual v1 party before start_battle captures the retry checkpoint. Upgrade/resave/reload/retry preserves grown characters.

fixed_findings.issue: Suspend and retry preflight accepted contradictory route/party/roster identities and unsafe unit metadata
fixed_findings.fix: Validate leader, membership union, roster key/unit identity/side and missing numeric/boolean metadata before mutating live state. Keep final merged parties and old missing fields compatible.

fixed_findings.issue: Story VM accepted another room, unsupported continuation PC and malformed NPC metadata
fixed_findings.fix: Validate current room, actual dialogue/choice checkpoint PC boundaries and actor movement/render metadata. Authentic dialogue and choice resume still reach chapter2.

fixed_findings.issue: One world action could allocate multiple queued armies plus an ordinary probability wave
fixed_findings.fix: Attempt only the first queued army; retain on failure and skip ordinary wave generation when a queue exists.

fixed_findings.issue: Source stationary army templates below60 were incorrectly moved
fixed_findings.fix: Keep fixed armies at their locations, including saves containing old movement metadata.

fixed_findings.issue: Forced Dragon Valley generator consumed an extra selection RNG roll
fixed_findings.fix: Skip ordinary generator selection for forced generator6. Seed146 wave4 now rejects at source roll78; previously the extra roll advanced to0 and spawned group76.

fixed_findings.issue: Enemy summon capacity counted commander slot0 incorrectly after casualty pruning or array reordering
fixed_findings.fix: Always reserve physical slot0 and prioritize enemy_slot metadata. The actual allocator already restricted slots1..19; no extra monster was claimed to have spawned.

validation.first_two_natural_battles: map1 victory turn3; map2 victory turn4; unmodified enemies
validation.external_directory_pack_test: FE2_PACK_VERIFY PASS; source army identities and new hub shortcut guard verified in packaged bytecode

fixture_corrections.change: Use real recruit() before capturing the retry snapshot, rather than assigning party while leaving parties.alm at its default; natural battle statistics unchanged.

remaining_limits: All80 entry/story/settlement fixtures do not establish one natural playthrough of all80 battles.
World armies still use world-action scheduling rather than original per-frame random ordering.
Save preflight covers the tested realistic malformed state/identity/VM cases, not arbitrary hostile dictionaries.
Missing historical per-army casualty identity in old saves cannot be reconstructed. Existing audio and presentation approximations remain.
environment_diagnostics: macOS CA read diagnostic; some old scene suites report object/resource cleanup warnings without script errors.
Resource pack export succeeds; sandbox refuses writing external Godot editor settings without affecting external-directory pack verification.
